subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Does the final structured log and doctor contract expose only metadata that is safe for every supported SecretRef owner, including web-tool and auth-store paths?
rationale: The code intentionally converts secret-resolution failures into operator-visible diagnostics; the acceptable disclosure boundary is a maintainer security and product decision rather than an automated repair choice.

options.title: Approve the redacted diagnostic contract
options.body: Merge after exact-head proof confirms cold and stale cases omit SecretRef identifiers, secret values, and provider-private resolution text.

options.title: Narrow the visible metadata
options.body: Retain generic degraded notifications but reduce owner identifiers or paths if maintainers consider any current owner form too sensitive.

recommendation.title: Approve the redacted diagnostic contract
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head proof confirms cold and stale cases omit SecretRef identifiers, secret values, and provider-private resolution text.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the current owner-isolation and degraded-owner behavior that defines the relevant disclosure boundary.
